scheme_name: Delhi Urban Farming & Rooftop Gardening Initiative
description: A flagship initiative by the Delhi Government to promote organic rooftop gardening, balcony micro-farming, and backyard vegetable cultivation across residential colonies and urban clusters in Delhi.
benefits: Free urban farming DIY kits, hands-on training workshops by horticulture experts, distribution of native seeds, organic compost, and technical support for vertical garden setups.
eligibility: Must be a resident of NCT of Delhi.
Individuals, Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), schools, or local community groups.
Access to adequate open space (rooftop, balcony, or backyard) with sunlight.
documents: Proof of Residence in Delhi (Electricity Bill / Voter ID)
application_mode: Online / Offline via Environment & Forest Dept

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) - Delhi Region
description: Promotes chemical-free organic farming in Delhi's rural and peri-urban belts (such as Najafgarh, Alipur, and South West Delhi) through cluster-based approaches and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, seeds, bio-fertilizers, cluster formation, packaging, and branding.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land in rural/peri-urban villages of Delhi.
Group of 20 or more farmers forming an organic farming cluster of 50 acres.
Willingness to adopt 100% organic techniques under PGS guidelines.
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture / Agriculture Extension Office

scheme_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH) - Delhi
description: Provides financial assistance to farmers in Delhi for setting up protected cultivation structures like shade net houses, polyhouses, and hi-tech nurseries for high-value floriculture and vegetable crops.
benefits: 50% to 60% credit-linked capital subsidy for polyhouse construction, drip fertigation systems, and high-quality plant nursery infrastructure.
eligibility: Individual farmers, FPOs, or agri-entrepreneurs in Delhi rural/peri-urban zones.
Must have clear title to land or registered lease agreement for minimum 10 years.
Assured source of irrigation at the project site.
documents: Land Records (Khasra/Khatoni) or Registered Lease Deed
application_mode: Online via MIDH / e-District Delhi Portal

scheme_name: Soil Health Card Scheme - NCT of Delhi
description: A government scheme to sample and analyze soil samples across Delhi's agricultural pockets to provide micro-nutrient status and customized fertilizer recommendations to farmers.
benefits: Free soil testing covering 12 critical parameters (N, P, K, pH, EC, Organic Carbon, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, B) and personalized crop-wise soil health cards.
eligibility: All farmers operating agricultural land within the NCT of Delhi.
application_mode: Offline via Village Agri-Extension Officer / District Labs

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Micro Irrigation Delhi
description: Focuses on 'More Crop Per Drop' by incentivizing water-saving technologies like drip and sprinkler irrigation systems for crops and orchards in Delhi's peri-urban agricultural belts.
benefits: 45% to 55% subsidy on the total cost of installing micro-irrigation systems (drip/sprinkler) connected to farm tube wells or water storage structures.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land or long-term lease holders in Delhi.
Functional water source (borewell/pond) with pump set.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (ACABC) - Delhi Region
description: Supports agricultural graduates and diploma holders in Delhi to set up commercial agri-ventures, expert advisory centers, custom hiring centers, and soil testing labs.
benefits: 45 days of free residential training, plus capital subsidy up to 36% (44% for SC/ST/Women) on bank loans up to ₹20 lakh for individual projects.
eligibility: Graduates or diploma holders in Agriculture, Horticulture, Animal Husbandry, or allied sciences.
Age above 18 years residing or operating in NCT of Delhi.

description: Financing facility for building post-harvest management infrastructure such as cold storages, pack houses, assaying units, and sorting/grading hubs in Delhi's wholesale and peri-urban markets.
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention on bank loans up to ₹2 crore for a maximum period of 7 years, alongside credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE.
eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), FPOs, Agri-Entrepreneurs, and Startups registered in Delhi.

description: Promotes modern, eco-friendly farm machinery like happy seeders, rotavators, electric tillers, and crop residue management equipment among farmers in Delhi to curb stubble burning.
benefits: Financial subsidy of 40% to 50% on individual machinery purchases or up to 80% for setting up Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
eligibility: Individual farmers, SHGs, and user groups operating in Delhi's farming villages.
Priority given to small and marginal farmers.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY) - Delhi UT Chapter
description: Provides flexible funding to Delhi's agriculture and animal husbandry departments to execute high-impact local interventions like hydroponics promotion, peri-urban mushroom cultivation, and dairy extension.
benefits: Financial assistance and grants up to 50% for specialized projects in hydroponics, vertical farming units, apiculture (beekeeping), and mushroom spawning.
eligibility: Farmers, self-help groups, and agri-entrepreneurs located in Delhi.
Must undergo mandatory technical training organized by the Department.
application_mode: Offline via Development Department, Govt of NCT Delhi

scheme_name: Livestock Health & Dairy Development Scheme - Delhi
description: Provides preventive healthcare, door-step artificial insemination, free vaccination drives, and fodder development support for cattle and dairy livestock reared in Delhi's rural and gaushala belts.
benefits: Free door-step veterinary health care services, free foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccinations, subsidized high-yielding fodder seeds, and artificial insemination kits.
eligibility: Dairy farmers, cattle rearers, and registered Gaushalas located within Delhi NCT boundaries.
application_mode: Offline via Government Veterinary Hospitals / Dispensaries in Delhi
